title: Ship-To Fulfillment Account Freight and Minimum Order Schedule
content:
**Corbett Industrial Supply — tariff schedule for the Ship-To Fulfillment Account.** The figures below are set per service level and are applied to each ship-to on its own.

| Service level | Free freight threshold (order merchandise subtotal, USD) | Standard freight flat charge (USD per shipment) | Standard ship method | Ship methods to which free freight applies | Consolidated daily shipment | Minimum order (USD) | Small order fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Corbett Parcel Ship-To | 250.00 | 14.95 | ground parcel | ground parcel, route truck, dedicated truck, will-call | no | 50.00 | 10.00 |
| Corbett Standard Ship-To | 150.00 | 12.95 | ground parcel | ground parcel, route truck, dedicated truck, will-call | no | 50.00 | 10.00 |
| Corbett Priority Ship-To | 100.00 | 9.95 | ground parcel | ground parcel, route truck, dedicated truck, will-call | yes | 25.00 | 7.50 |
| Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To | 0.00 | 0.00 | route truck | ground parcel, route truck, dedicated truck, will-call | yes | 25.00 | 7.50 |
| Corbett Premier Route Ship-To | 0.00 | 0.00 | route truck | ground parcel, route truck, dedicated truck, will-call | yes | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To | 0.00 | 0.00 | dedicated truck | ground parcel, route truck, dedicated truck, will-call | yes | 0.00 | 0.00 |

### What each column means

- **Free freight threshold** — the order merchandise subtotal, USD, at or above which standard-method freight is free; 0.00 means standard-method freight is always free.
- **Standard freight flat charge** — the flat standard-method freight charge per order shipment below the free freight threshold, USD.
- **Standard ship method** — the ship method used when the customer does not ask for another.
- **Ship methods to which free freight applies** — the ship methods to which the free freight threshold and route free delivery apply; other methods are always charged.
- **Consolidated daily shipment** — whether all orders for the ship-to released on one business day ship together and count as one shipment for freight.
- **Minimum order** — the order merchandise subtotal, USD, below which the small order fee applies; 0.00 means no minimum.
- **Small order fee** — the small order fee per order below the minimum, USD.

### Reading the schedule

- A Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To, Corbett Premier Route Ship-To or Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To has a threshold of 0.00, so its standard-method freight is always free.
- A Corbett Premier Route Ship-To or Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To has a minimum of 0.00, so it has no minimum order.
- Second day air, next day air, LTL freight and manufacturer drop ship are not among the methods to which free freight applies at any level.

*Hypothetical illustration:* at a level with a threshold of 100.00, an order whose merchandise subtotal is exactly 100.00 is at the threshold, so its standard-method freight is free; a subtotal of 99.99 is below it.
